description: Look up case(s) by short case number (e.g. 26-10543). FREE for 7-digit format (limited fields, all courts). Paid lookups return the full record. Pass court with the court name from a case result to limit the lookup to one court. Does not contact the court.

court.description: Court name as returned in the court field, for example "Delaware" or "Texas Southern".

court_state.description: 2-letter state. Matches every district in that state.

name: get_case_by_case_number_tool
title: Find case by case number
